programme.title: 90 dana: Potraga za ljubavlju
programme.desc: Osmoro iz serijala "90 dana" spremno je da pruži ljubavi novu šansu u tropskom raju, krećući na putovanje ispunjeno romantikom i novim počecima.

programme.title: Veridba od 90 dana: U inostranstvu
programme.desc: Džesi je spremna da rizikuje sve u Italiji. Endi sumnja u preseljenje u Australiju. Džon i Ali kriju trudnoću, a Najls planira povratak u Ganu.

programme.title: Moj prelep život sa viškom kilograma
programme.desc: Posle Babsinog moždanog udara, porodica pokušava da se nosi s novom situacijom. Kada primi neočekivanu ponudu, Vitni mora da bira između porodice i karijere plesačice.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Their bodies have long turned to dust, but the spirits of the original owners who built Bellewood remain in charge and don't mind chasing out tresspassers.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine the devastating power of floods. Defined as water covering land not normally submerged, floods can unleash terror through raging currents and flash floods. Disasters like Brazilian landslides, Hurricane Katrina, and the 2004 tsunami killed hundreds of thousands and displaced millions. Urbanization worsens flooding by reducing soil absorption. Better building codes and coordinated relief could reduce destruction, but floods remain a deadly force of nature.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The team learns to expect the unexpected, as objects move on their own and unexplained sounds plague the investigators.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the 'Birdman of Loro Parque', proudly leads the Foundation's ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he's hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures

This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico's Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Early computers include the Antikythera device and Babbage's engines, though his designs were ahead of their time. WWII accelerated the need for powerful calculators. Early machines were massive but weak. The invention of the transistor in the 1950s replaced bulky vacuum tubes, enabling personal computers. Today, supercomputers help design planes, buildings—even target genes. Computers are evolving fast—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The team explores St. Albans, a former sanitarium, and captures several shocking EVPs (spirit voices), including the one that became the title of this episode.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos' the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Finally for this series, we are exploring the world of nocturnal animals—creatures adapted to thrive in darkness. Escaping predators, avoiding heat, and sharing resources, they emerge as night falls. Join porcupines, raccoons, mice, cats, foxes, and more on their nightly journey. From raccoons with sensitive touch to mice surviving in teams, each is a master of the night. Across continents, these animals—like the fruit-loving porcupine—showcase fear, excitement, and survival in the shadows.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals evolve through small mutations to better compete for resources. Crocodiles, over 200 million years old, survived extinction due to their adaptability—slow metabolism, 4-chamber heart, and lungs that allow 2-hour dives. Sharks retained successful traits from ancient ancestors, evolving gradually. Whales transitioned from land to sea, developing echolocation, blubber, modified lungs, and enhanced hearing for survival.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Paper wasn't always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Radio waves, born from electromagnetism, power wireless tech like phones, TVs, and RADAR. Though invisible, they've transformed society. Discoveries by Galvani, Franklin, and Oersted revealed their power. From melting chocolate to X-rays, EM waves penetrate everything—even the human body. Now, they're helping us explore the brain. What's next for this invisible force?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the "Bear" truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone's favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally "Slink" its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We visit the old south and enjoy some sweet tea in Savannah. On this episode, we'll stroll the city's beautiful squares, as well as visit it's civil war past at Old Fort Jackson. Then, we head up the stairs of the famous Tybee Island lighthouse and visit the Savannah Railroad museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: There's a lot to cover in the oldest city in America. Take a sip from the distinctively tasting Fountain of Youth. Then we'll cross the draw bridge of the undefeated Spanish Fort, the Castillo San Marcos. Then we'll learn the true history of pirates at the Pirate Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.desc: Join us as we cruise the backwaters of Kerala, one of the most beautiful and serene areas of India. We explore the cities of Cochin and Kozhikode. Attend a local theatre performance and learn about traditional drama styles. The drama continues as we witness a local festival and then take in a display of the ancient art of Kalaripayattu. Bill helps raise the Chinese fishing nets at dusk and tour a 1000 year old boat yard, where luxury vessels are still handcrafted.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Every major country has a destination that is incredible but not well known to outsiders—Jaisalmer is such a place. Once a major stop along the silk road, this living museum and surrounding countryside has something for everyone: tragic history, unbelievable architecture, unique cultural groups and resilient wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is one of the few national parks in Africa where the bush meets the ocean. The big game of Africa face off with the creatures of the deep. Our host goes a little rogue for supper and tries his hand at surf netting prawns after spending a day looking for the elusive elephants of Saadani.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In all previous Journeys' shows, only glimpses of the cheetah were seen. Here at Kruger, we get up close to this shy cat before heading out of the park and visiting a special research and breeding center dedicated to cheetahs.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A look into the world and culture of snowmobiling; the fans, the lifestyle and the sport.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Witness kayaking from all over the world. China, Kyrgyzstan and Costa Rica to explore surf, remote rivers and virgin waterfalls.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars. As we prepare to land humans on the red planet, getting there is one thing; staying long term is another, can we really conquor this planet?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space. We humans cannot yet travel that sort of distance, however w e can and do send our robots and probes in our place; and the results are astounding.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Before computer drawing programs, there was a toy that if you mastered its two circular white knobs you could have a picture perfect sketch. We'll explain how the etch a sketch drew onto the scene. And what did Neil Armstrong really say when he stepped on the moon, the "aahh" answer will surprise you! Plus, where did the explosive name bikini come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: On a hot summer's day, nothing cools you down like a frozen fruity popsicle! You'll learn how an 11-year old boy created this sweet icy treat! And, have you ever noticed those colored spinning poles outside the barbershop? You'll be in stitches when you learn how they got their start! Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the microwave!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Među srednjovekovnim gradovima, gustim šumama i vijugavim ulicama, Kertis juri za psima u potrazi za tartufima. Potom dobija obuku od majstora porčete. Usavršava umeće klanja golubova kako bi spremio jelo koje koristi sve delove ptice.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci

programme.title: Prijatno

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Salata od krompira je klasično jelo. Lora i Stojan spremiće je na drugačiji i ukusniji način. Milanski kotleti biće ohlađeni na nesvakidašnji način. Za desert sledi torta od smeđeg putera sa glazurom.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Ova epizoda posvećena je jelima koja radni dan mogu da pretvore u godišnji odmor. Sve počinje toplom čorbom sa kobasicama i testeninom orzo. Piletina sa pirinčem, puterom i izgnječenom šargarepom lako se priprema i izgleda prelepo.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Nema ništa složeno kod ovih recepata. Nema skupih ili egzotičnih sastojaka, dugotrajnog kuvanja ili posebnih tehnika. Svejedno, svi će biti opčinjeni, kako izgledom ovih jela, tako i njihovim bogatim ukusom. Sve počinje salatom od boranije.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Prijatelji dolaze u goste. Ima li išta lepše od toga? Šta će biti na meniju? Lora i Stojan će podeliti nekoliko ideja. Na primer, odličan humus od cvekle, kolumbijski kukuruzni hleb i prelepe ćufte od patlidžana.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan u ovoj epizodi nude savršen meni dostojan rođendana. Za predjelo labne, koji se pravi od grčkog jogurta, orašastih plodova i mešavine začina, od kojih je najvažniji timijan. Ćufte su od ćuretine, a torta je od jogurta i borovnica.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Brzi i uksuni, tako možemo da opišemo recepte koje su Lora i Stojan spremili za ovu epizodu. Salata je od tikvice i šargarepe, a palačinka je sa povrćem i kobasicama. Treći recept je za goveđe rolnice sa paprikama.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan će podeliti recepte koji su pogodni za nedeljni porodični ručak. Na primer, čorba od paradajza sa pečenim lukom i sirom halumi. Zatim piletina adobo i desert od šumskog voća.

programme.title: Veliki Mekong: Luk Nuen
programme.desc: U sedmoj epizodi serijala "Veliki Mekong: Luk Nuen" voditelj se penje do sela države Šan i grada Keng Tung, u Mjanmaru. Ovde, Luk priprema neka neobična jela i omiljenu hranu sa lokalne pijace.

programme.title: Veliki Mekong: Luk Nuen
programme.desc: U osmoj epizodi serijala, Luk dolazi u grad Čiang Kong na severu Tajlanda, gde lovi ribu za svoju "Tom Jam" riblju čorbu. Zatim priprema ukusni žablji kari, koji se priprema na severu Tajlanda.

programme.title: Rik Stajn: Put do Meksika
programme.desc: Rik odlazi u glavni grad koji, iako deluje usko na karti, ima čak tri vremenske zone. Zbog toga ga lokalci prosto zovu Meksiko i nije se mnogo promenio otkada je bio centar Astečkog carstva. Scene sa murala Dijega Rivere i dalje krase grad.

programme.title: Džejmijevi laki i jednostavni recepti
programme.desc: Džejmi se vraća sa novim serijalom lakih i jednostavnih recepata. Ove nedelje sprema četiri jela. Za početak sprema brze i lake svinjske kolenice vrhunskog ukusa. Zatim sprema jelo od baštenskog povrća, od graška, pasulja, čilija i mente.

programme.title: Džejmijevi laki i jednostavni recepti
programme.desc: Ove nedelje u serijalu "Džejmijevi laki i jednostavni recepti" Džejmi sprema neverovatno jednostavne i ukusne obroke. Za početak sprema dimljeni bakalar. To je savršeno riblje jelo kada ste u žurbi. Zatim sprema azijsko jelo punog ukusa.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Kuvar Akis Petretzikis vraća se sa 10 živopisnih epizoda mediteranskih gozbi i neodoljivih deserta. Od porodičnih pečenja do rashlađenih kolača i grčkih klasika, 5. sezona donosi jednostavne, ukusne recepte za svakodnevne obroke i posebna okupljanja.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom

programme.title: Džimijevi Ukusi Floride

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši

Ali dečak počinje da preispituje pravu prirodu tih prikaza, primoran da se suoči sa istinom o sudbini svog oca i zloj sili koja preti da ga obuzme.

programme.title: Londonski bulevar
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo u konfuznoj i haotičnoj situaciji. Sajmon Mari bori se za francusku Legiju stranaca. Paskal Dipon bori se samo za sebe. Ljudi u ratu preispituju čast, nadu i moral. Jer, od svega se može pobeći, osim od sebe.

programme.title: Knjiga od krvi
programme.desc: Stručnjak za paranormalno otkriva kuću na raskršću takozvanih "autoputeva", kojima se duše transportuju na onaj svet.

programme.title: Noćna tabla

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kada svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće prizore dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Kancelarija na ćošku
programme.desc: U ovoj komediji o kancelarijskom životu, savesni službenik Orson pronalazi utočište u praznoj kancelariji, daleko od napornih kolega. Međutim, njegov neobičan izbor izaziva neočekivano negodovanje i pokreće niz apsurdnih događaja.

programme.title: Reči
programme.desc: Pisac se suočava s mračnom tajnom.

programme.title: Legenda o Zorou
programme.desc: Iako pokušava da ostavi viteške pustolovine iza sebe, pretnja po Kaliforniju, državu u nastajanju, primorava Dona Alehandra de la Vegu i njegovu suprugu Elenu da ponovo stupe u akciju.

programme.title: Praktične devojke
programme.desc: Dve bogate sestre, naslednice porodičnog kozmetičkog carstva, suočavaju se sa surovom realnošću kada ih skandal i istraga ostave bez nasledstva.

programme.title: Zvezda za Božić
programme.desc: Rajli je umetnički direktor Onota teatra. Kada Redžina, vlasnica teatra, najavi prodaju prostora za Božić, Rajli angažuje njenog sestrića, TV zvezdu Sema Kembela, za ulogu Boba Kračeta u "Božićnoj priči" kako bi iskoristila njegovu slavu i ubedila je da odustane od prodaje.

programme.title: Postanje
programme.desc: Engleski prirodnjak Čarls Darvin pokušava da pronađe ravnotežu između svojih revolucionarnih teorija o evoluciji i odnosa s religioznom suprugom, čija je vera u apsolutnoj suprotnosti s njegovim životnim delom.

programme.title: Udovice
programme.desc: "Udovice" je priča o četiri žene koje nemaju ništa zajedničko osim ogromnih dugova koje su, nakon života praćenog kriminalnim aktivnostima, njihovi pokojni muževi ostavili za sobom. U modernom Čikagu, situacija se komplikuje kada Veronika (Viola Dejvis), Alisa (Elizabet Debiki), Linda (Mišel Rodrigez) i Bela (Sintija Erivo) uzmu sudbinu u svoje ruke, rešene da budućnost skroje prema sopstvenoj zamisli.

programme.title: Na pogrešnom putu
programme.desc: Četvorica mladića upuštaju se u rizičnu investiciju, koja ih vodi u sukob s mafijom.

programme.title: Ponoć u plavoj travi
programme.desc: FBI agent i savezni policajac iz Floride udružuju se kako bi istražili niz nerešenih ubistava.

programme.desc: Potraga bivšeg agenta CIA za otetom ćerkom uvlači ga u mrežu političkih spletki, korupcije, opasnosti i izdaje.

programme.title: Ubistvo predsednika srednje škole
programme.desc: U katoličkoj srednjoj školi, popularna devojka udružuje se s novinarkom iz drugog razreda kako bi istražile slučaj ukradenih SAT ispita. Kada dvojac usmeri sumnje prema osumnjičenima, otkriva se mnogo veća zavera.

programme.title: Kosmički greh
programme.desc: Sedmoro odmetnutih vojnika započinje preventivni udar na novootkrivenu vanzemaljsku civilizaciju, u nadi da će okončati međuzvezdani rat pre nego što je zapravo započeo.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Pirati sa Velikog Slanog Jezera
programme.desc: Kirk Redgrejv je sanjar koji živi s majkom, sve dok njegovo tajno piratsko životarenje ne bude otkriveno i primora ga na selidbu. Sa sobom vodi simpatičnog Flinta i zajedno kreću na Veliko slano jezero, praveći haos među slučajnim turistima i amaterskim mornarima. Kada naiđu na pravu mapu ukletog blaga, počinje luda potraga u kojoj ih prate čudni likovi takođe u lovu na bogatstvo. Ovo je zabavna i neobična priča o prijateljstvu i najluđim fantazijama dvojice ekscentrika.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Visina
programme.desc: Agentu FBI ponuđeni su milioni da pomogne lopovu da pobegne iz otetog aviona.

programme.title: Izgubljeno blago Džesija Džejmsa
programme.desc: Tim dece iz Misurija pokušava da reši sto godina staru misteriju i spasi svoje prijatelje u ovoj porodičnoj akcionoj avanturi. Duboko u drevne pećine, oni moraju da pobegnu lovcima na blago koji su im za petama, ili da budu zauvek izgubljeni.

programme.title: Ponovo pisati
programme.desc: Oskarom nagrađeni pisac, koji je zapao u krizu, napušta Holivud i odlazi na Istočnu obalu da predaje pisanje scenarija na fakultetu. Tu se zaljubljuje u samohranu majku, studentkinju tog fakulteta.

programme.title: Klik - Za savršen život
programme.desc: Mikl Njumen, oženjeni muškarac opsednut poslom, nema vremena za svoju suprugu i decu; ne ako želi da impresionira svog nezahvalnog šefa i dobije zasluženo unapređenje. Kada upozna Mortija, luckastog prodavca, dobija odgovor na svoje molitve: magični daljinski upravljač koji mu omogućava da preskoči sitne životne smetnje, uz urnebesne posledice.

programme.title: Priča o Džejn Ostin
programme.desc: Biografski portret mlade Džejn Ostin pre slave i romanse s mladim Ircem.

programme.title: Krvoproliće
programme.desc: Priča o srdačnom susretu četvoro roditelja, nakon tuče u školskom dvorištu između njihovih sinova.

programme.title: Mali diktator
programme.desc: Lenji diplomirani pravnik usvaja dete kako bi zadivio devojku, ali ništa ne ide po planu. Sada mora da odraste i nauči kako da se nosi sa izazovima očinstva.

programme.title: Leto '72
programme.desc: Na pragu ulaska u visoko društvo, dvadesetdvogodišnji diplomac Bili Mičel menja planove kada se zaljubi u pacijentkinju s poremećajem višestruke ličnosti u psihijatrijskoj ustanovi svog oca.

programme.title: Dnevnik opijanja
programme.desc: Krajem pedesetih godina prošlog veka, neuspeli pisac postaje radnik propalog časopisa u Portoriku, gde upada u kandže alkohola, postaje deo sumnjive šeme za eksploataciju zemljišta i zaljubljuje se u prelepu, ali verenu ženu.

programme.title: Na kraju sveta
programme.desc: Saravak, na severoistoku ostrva Borneo, 1839. godine. Gotovo sasvim slučajno, sultan od Bruneja postavlja britanskog avanturistu Džejmsa Bruka na poziciju radže. Kao nezavistan vladar kreće u lični krstaški pohod protiv pirata, ropstva i lova na glave, dok istovremeno pokušava da obuzda zlonamerne ekspanzionističke ambicije Britanske imperije.

programme.title: Duh
programme.desc: Odnedavno ožalošćeni otac vodi svoju ćerku u novi grad, ali ubrzo shvata da je njihova nova kuća iz viktorijanskog perioda ukleta.

programme.title: Humanitarni biro
programme.desc: U bliskoj budućnosti naša vlada odlučivaće o tome ko je potrošna roba.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Gvido superstar: Gvidov uspon
programme.desc: U ovoj urnebesnoj akcionoj komediji italijanski doseljenik upada u svet narko-bosova, superautomobila i tajnih agenata. Nakon što je izgubio posao u kompaniji Disko Valet zbog neumesnog junaštva, Gvido mora za FBI da izigrava sicilijanskog gangstera kako bi se infiltrirao u moćnu azijsku bandu. Stvari kreću naopako i postaju sve gore. Gvido to mora da ispravi pre nego što ga otkriju i ubiju ili, još gore, deportuju.

programme.title: Operacija "Panda"
programme.desc: Međunarodna akciona zvezda Džeki Čen pozvan je na ceremoniju usvajanja retkog mladunčeta pande. Ali kada međunarodni kriminalni sindikat pokuša da ga otme, Džeki mora da ga spase, oslanjajući se na svoje veštine i vratolomije koje su neizbežne u njegovim borilačkim filmovima.

programme.title: Skor: Mjuzikl na ledu
programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji Farli je vodio bezbedan život: školovan kod kuće, jeo organsku hranu i posećivao umetničke galerije. Na zaprepašćenje svojih roditelja, Farli voli da igra hokej sa decom iz komšiluka. Stvar je dodatno zakomplikovana kada ga primeti vlasnik omladinskog tima, koji ga odmah uzima pod svoje i on postaje zvezda. Ali brzo otkriva da slava ima cenu, uključujući i očekivanje da se bori na ledu. Kad se tome doda kvarenje odnosa s najboljim prijateljem, Farli shvata da ništa ne ide kako bi trebalo.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Čarobnjak i bela zmija
programme.desc: Ching Siu-Tung režira film zasnovan na kineskoj legendi o travaru koji se zaljubljuje u Belu Zmiju staru hiljadu godina, prerušenu u ženu. Jet Li glumi čarobnjaka koji otkriva pravi identitet zmije i započinje borbu za dušu muškarca.

programme.title: Obućar
programme.desc: "Kobler" govori o obućaru, četvrtoj generaciji u porodičnom poslu, koji pronalazi magičnu šivaću mašinu u podrumu svog oca. Mašina mu omogućava da živi živote svih ljudi koji nose njegove cipele.

programme.title: Operacija "Morski vuk"
programme.desc: U poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, Nemačka, očajna i u potrazi za poslednjom šansom da porazi saveznike, okuplja svoje preostale podmornice za završnu misiju: napad na kontinentalne Sjedinjene Države.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni
programme.desc: Džordž je mentalno oboleli beskućnik, koji već godinama nije u stanju da zadrži posao. On luta gradom tražeći hranu, alkohol i sklonište, ali sve vreme pokušava da ostvari kontakt sa svojom ćerkom. Džordž se obraća njujorškoj socijalnoj službi, ali mu za potrebnu finansijsku pomoć nedostaju dokumenta. Tada postaje prijatelj s drugim beskućnikom, koji tvrdi da je bio uspešni džez muzičar.

programme.title: Život kakav jeste
programme.desc: Dok mladi njujorški par prolazi put od studentske romanse do braka i rođenja prvog deteta, neočekivani preokreti na tom putovanju odjekuju kroz kontinente i generacije.

programme.title: Usponi i padovi
programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo rađa se između neuspešnog stendap komičara iz Los Anđelesa, koji je prinuđen da se pognute glave vrati kući na Long Ajlend, i tragično nesavršenog, ali šarmantnog i harizmatičnog dermatologa alkoholičara. Otkrivajući da su srodne duše, jedan drugom pomažu da pronađu isceljenje i samopouzdanje da se suoče sa neuspesima u svojim životima.

programme.title: Đavolje trojstvo
programme.desc: U burnoj Montani 1870-ih, osuđenik Ajzak Brodvej pred pogubljenje poverava otuđenom sinu Henriju nemoguć zadatak: da ubije čoveka koji ga je lažno optužio. Henrijeva potraga vodi ga u zabačeni gradić Triniti, gde se nalazi između pravednog šerifa Gabrijela Dava i tajanstvenog stranca po imenu Sent Kristofer.

programme.title: Pakao na točkovima: najsmrtonosniji putevi na svetu
programme.desc: Godine 2020, više od 1,35 miliona ljudi izgubilo je život u saobraćajnim nesrećama širom sveta, dok je više od 50 miliona povređeno. To znači da u proseku svakog dana u saobraćajnim nesrećama pogine oko 3.700 ljudi — što je ekvivalent sedam velikih avionskih nesreća dnevno. Bilo da ste u Aziji, Evropi, Americi, Africi ili Okeaniji, uvek igrate lutriju, rizikujući da postanete žrtva saobraćajne nesreće. Niko nije zaista imun: ako ste na putu, u opasnosti ste. Otkrijte sve o globalnoj epidemiji saobraćajnih nesreća u napetoj trodelnoj dokumentarnoj seriji "Pakao na točkovima: najsmrtonosniji putevi na svetu". Svaka 52-minutna epizoda vas vodi na putovanje visokog napona, uz hrabre muškarce i žene koji su na prvim linijama ovih tragedija — vatrogasce, policajce, vozače šlep službi, ili novinare, koji neretko prvi stižu na mesto nesreće. Čućemo svedočenja žrtava i analize saobraćajnih stručnjaka, dok uz pomoć detaljnih 3D prikaza i šokantnih snimaka sa mesta događaja rekonstruišemo trenutak sudara. Ova serija donosi potresnu i poučnu istragu o najsmrtonosnijim putevima sveta, podsećajući nas da svako, bilo gde, može biti sledeći.

programme.title: Nazanin
programme.desc: Nazanin je moćan promatrački dokumentarac koji pruža do sada neviđen pristup i uvodi nas duboko u središte jedne od najznačajnijih ljudskih i međunarodnih priča u poslednjih šest godina. Delimično ljubavna priča, delimično triler, Nazanin je film velikog srca, a donosi zloslutno upozorenje iz istorije.Ovo je duboko ličan i emotivan portret obične porodice uhvaćene između zlokobnih sila međunarodnih afera i tajni koje su van njihove kontrole. Ovo je svedočanstvo ljudskoj hrabrosti, otpornosti i važnosti borbe za ljubav i porodicu.

programme.title: Černobilska katastrofa
programme.desc: Katastrofa u Černobilju, dokumentarna serija u tri dela koju pripoveda Ben Fogle, iz minuta u minut prikazuje dramatične događaje koji su prethodili nuklearnoj nesreći 1986. godine, kao i borbu hiljada hrabrih ljudi da spreče dalje širenje katastrofe. Kroz svedočenja ljudi koji su se neposredno našli u središtu tragedije, onih koji su rizikovali živote učestvujući u saniranju posledica, kao i kroz analizu nedavno objavljenih dokumenata KGB-a, serijal otkriva neverovatnu istinitu priču o jednoj od najtežih nuklearnih nesreća u istoriji. Serijal se bavi i dugoročnim posledicama černobiljske katastrofe, uključujući događaje iz 2022. godine, kada su ruske snage tokom rata u Ukrajini preuzele kontrolu nad područjem Černobilja.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: Svet po Kimu Džong-Unu
programme.desc: Uoči 75. rođendana Korejske narodne armije, Kim Džong-Un je rešen da zemlju učini vodećom nuklearnom silom na svetu. Odbacujući svaku mogućnost razoružanja, vođa umesto toga jača svoj arsenal testiranjem svoje "čudovišne rakete" Hvasong-17. Nikada do sada severnokorejska nuklearna pretnja nije bila ovako snažna. Čemu takva opsesija nuklearnim oružjem? Koliko ozbiljno treba da shvatimo ovu novu pretnju? Da li je Kim Džong-Un zaista toliko nepredvidiv kako se tvrdi i zbog čega nastoji da provocira čitavu planetu? Ovo su pitanja koja postavlja ovaj istraživački dokumentarac, s ciljem da se razume šta se to dešava severno od 38. paralele, u despotskom svetu severnokorejskog vođe.

programme.title: Ljubav i seks
programme.desc: Kao i mnoge druge zemlje Latinske Amerike, Meksiko se, kada je reč o seksu, često povezuje sa mačizmom i verskim konzervativizmom. Ipak, glavni grad je oduvek bio jedan od najprogresivnijih u regionu, dok pojedini autohtoni narodi pokazuju toleranciju prema seksualnim manjinama kakva ne postoji ni u mnogim evropskim zemljama. Meksičko društvo, sa 130 miliona stanovnika, složeno je i puno suprotnosti.

programme.title: Kako radi Amazon: Tajne XXL logistike
programme.desc: U srcu logističkih zona, često nevidljivih široj javnosti, Amazonova robotska skladišta predstavljaju oličenje nove ere rada i distribucije. Iza njihovih anonimnih fasada, neumoljivi balet autonomnih mašina, ultrabrzih transportnih traka i algoritama koordinira sortiranje, skladištenje i isporuku miliona proizvoda. Ovaj dokumentarac uranja u srž ovih modernih katedrala potrošnje, gde ljudi i mašine koegzistiraju u precizno tempiranom ritmu. Istražuje fascinantnu preciznost Kiva robota, nevidljivo mapiranje koje usmerava svaki paket, i procese osmišljene da svedu svaki ljudski pokret na strogi minimum. Performanse, profitabilnost, veštačka inteligencija i tehnološka fascinacija: kroz robotsku koreografiju, intimna svedočenja i analizu stručnjaka, ovaj dokumentarac otvara vrata u svet koji već oblikuje našu svakodnevicu

programme.title: Prevareni ste!
programme.desc: Ljudi su žrtve prevara od početka civilizacije, ali danas su se prevare pretvorile u krizu epidemskih proporcija. Zahvaljujući internetu, jedna lukava prevara može da odžepari hiljade ili milione ljudi. Smatramo da će nas kompjuteri spasiti, ali zapravo, mi smo najslabija karika u odbrani kompjutera. 84% prevaranata koriste naše ljudske slabosti. Ranjivosti poput poverenja, pohlepe, straha i ljubavi nas teraju da se ponašamo na načine zbog kojih se posle kajemo. Socijalni inženjering prevaranata pokušava da nas tera da postupamo protiv sopstvenog interesa. Da li nekako možemo da se zaštitimo bolje? Koristeći psihologiju ljudske prirode, društvene eksperimente i realne prevare, psiholog Najdžel Lata će dokazati da smo svi mi ranjivi, iako 90% nas veruje da ne može da bude prevareno.

programme.title: Ekstremni avioni
programme.desc: Ova nova serija istražuje šta se dešava kada letovi izgube kontrolu. Prepuni putnički avion koji se zapalio samo nekoliko trenutaka pre poletanja. Avion koji se srušio na prometnu autoput. Panika u pilotskoj kabini koja je izazvala katastrofalnu nesreću. Porodični zabavni let koji je završio katastrofom kada je sudar u vazduhu ostavio porodicu da slobodno pada kroz goruće ostatke sa visine od 12.000 stopa. I spasilačka misija u planinama koja je krenula veoma, veoma loše... Kroz ove priče i mnoge druge, snimci koje su zabeležili putnici, iskazi preživelih srećnika iz prve ruke, kao i stručna analiza vanrednih situacija koje su dovele do ovih zapanjujućih događaja, sve se kombinuje kako bi se ispričala priča o ekstremnim letovima i vazduhoplovnim hitnim situacijama.

programme.title: Najveće inženjerske katastrofe
programme.desc: Naučnici proučavaju svet kakav jeste, političari raspravljaju o svetu kakav žele, ali inženjeri stvaraju svet koji nikada nije postojao. Industrijalizacija, distribucija vode, elektrifikacija, automatizacija i komunikacije _ sve su to inženjerske revolucije koje su transformisale naš svet i promenile svaki detalj naših života. Međutim, za svaku izgrađenu budućnost postoje ljudske greške koje uzrokuju katastrofalne nesreće. Trenuci nalik Ikarovom padu, kada naše preterivanje, pohlepa i želja da osvojimo nemoguće ne koštaju samo reputacije, već milione dolara, uzrokuju ekološku štetu i odnose živote. Černobil, Bhopal, Deepwater Horizon, Titanik, Čelendžer i Hindenburg nisu zapamćeni po velikim inženjerskim dostignućima kakva su prvobitno bila, već po užasima u koje su se pretvorili. Kroz opsežne arhivske materijale i intervjue sa stručnjacima, ova serija istražuje priče iza najvećih inženjerskih katastrofa čovečanstva. Kako i zašto su se dogodile i šta smo iz njih naučili. Katastrofe nas uče više nego uspesi; svaki neuspeh pruža priliku za napredak i inovaciju, jer najveća tragedija bi bila nikada ne težiti napretku.

programme.title: Forenzičari: Stvarni CSI
programme.desc: Više kamera u realnom vremenu prati istrage teških krivičnih dela i otkriva presudnu ulogu koju savremena forenzička nauka danas ima u privođenju kriminalaca pravdi. Prateći slučajeve od istraga silovanja do ubistava, serijal prikazuje fascinantan put pojedinačnih dokaza _ od trenutka kada su pronađeni na mestu zločina, preko detaljne mikroskopske analize u specijalizovanim laboratorijama, pa sve do otkrivanja ključnog uticaja koji ti nalazi imaju na tok svake istrage. Radeći pod stalnim pritiskom ograničenog "forenzičkog vremenskog okvira", dok se metode kriminalaca neprestano menjaju i razvijaju, ovi stručnjaci veoma dobro znaju koliko su njihovi rezultati važni. Njihov rad može odlučiti da li će nevina osoba završiti iza rešetaka ili će krivac ostati na slobodi.

programme.title: Greška ubice
programme.desc: Služeći se dirljivim intervjuima i dramatičnim rekonstrukcijama, emisija "Greška ubice" istražuje fatalne greške koje su na kraju vodile do hapšenja. Priča svake žrtve je ispričana pomoću toka policijske istrage, tokom kojih su detektivi gradili slučajeve od najmanjih dokaza. Mrlje krvi, snimci sa skrivenih nadzornih kamera, pogrešna reč kazana u pogrešnom trenutku... Šta od toga može da oda ubicu? To otkrivamo na kraju svake epizode koja nosi intrigu, izazov i složenu tematiku, u seriji koja je dirljiva, ali i upućuje nas u proces istrage. Sve zavisi od jednog malog dokaza... A ako se dođe do njega, ubica ostaje slobodan.

programme.title: Na mestu zločina
programme.desc: Kada se suoče sa zločinom, za istražitelje postoji samo jedno rešenje: izneti tragove na videlo! Savršen zločin ne postoji. Napad, otmica, ubistvo… osumnjičeni uvek ostavlja tragove za sobom. Kako bi privukla pažnju gledalaca, serija koristi vizuelni stil nalik seriji CSI, koji pomaže da se svaki trag bolje razume. Svaka epizoda zasnovana je na deset tragova, predstavljenih kao razbacani delovi jezive slagalice. Gledalac postepeno otkriva ulogu svakog traga u slučaju, sve dok se na kraju ne razotkrije istina. Svaka epizoda donosi uzbudljivu i fascinantnu priču koja publiku drži u neizvesnosti do samog kraja. Stvarnost je jača od fikcije!

programme.title: Preživeli smo napad serijskog ubice
programme.desc: Neki su preživeli susret oči u oči sa ubicom i živeli da ispričaju priču. U serijalu "Preživeli smo napad serijskog ubice", istražujemo lične priče ljudi koji su to upravo učinili. Bilo da je reč o strancu, prijatelju ili ljubavniku, ovi hrabri pojedinci odlučili su da progovore o svom bliskom susretu sa zlom. Detaljni intervjui pružaju gledaocima forenzički uvid u to kako je izgledalo gledati u oči ubicu, dok žrtve dele vlastito iskustvo preživljavanja.

programme.title: Lov na čoveka: Fantomski ubica policajaca
programme.desc: Bari Prudom bio je najtraženiji čovek u Britaniji. Otac dvoje dece pretvorio se u očajničkog ubicu koji je pokrenuo najveću oružanu policijsku poteru koju je zemlja do tada videla. Čak 1.000 policajaca iz 12 različitih policijskih jedinica dve nedelje je pretraživalo Zapadni Jorkšir u potrazi za beguncem koji je ubio dvojicu policajaca i jednog lokalnog penzionera. Skrivajući se po šumama i selima, Prudom je izbegavao hapšenje nizom neverovatnih bekstava zbog kojih je dobio nadimak "Fantom". Preživljavao je skrivajući se u prirodi i koristeći ono što je mogao da pronađe.

programme.title: DNK dokazi
programme.desc: Pomoću revolucije u forenzici, zastareli slučajevi širom sveta se napokon rešavaju, a emisija "DNK dokazi" istražuje i prenosi priče najneverovatnijih slučajeva koji su do sada rešeni. Pomoću iskaza svedoka, novih razgovora, arhivskih snimaka i dramatičnih rekonstrukcija, "DNK dokazi" donosi uzbudljiv televizijski program koji će nam otkriti nove i dinamične oblike borbe protiv kriminala. Svaka jednočasovna epizoda prikazuje rad detektiva na rešavanju zastarelih slučajeva pomoću DNK članova porodica, i način na koji te dodatne DNK informacije prave revoluciju u genetskom profilisanju pri rešavanju slučajeva. Uz pomoć svedočenja očevidaca, novih razgovora s forenzičkim i psihološkim stručnjacima, kao i uz rekonstrukciju zločina pomešanu s arhivskim snimcima, ova serija predstavlja studiju savremene i futurističke tehnologije rešavanja zločina. Oni će nam pokazati na koji način se ustaljene metode istrage mogu poboljšati uz pomoć forenzike, i na koji način profilisanje DNK srodnika menja svet. Svaka epizoda u ovom serijalu počinje nasilnim zločinom koji je izvršen iz nepoznatog razloga, koji je kasnije ostao nerešen i dobro propraćen slučaj u javnosti SAD ili Britanije. Ovaj serijal prati modele istrage po kojima su otkriveni Ubica iz Golden Stejta, Noćobdija i druge ubice koji su na kraju ulovljene pomoću tehnike analize DNK srodnika. Pravi obrt u ovoj priči se otkriva uz pomoć forenzičara koji vode gledaoce (i detektive) kroz nove procese analize DNK, tzv. srodničkog DNK. To nas na kraju dovodi do razrešenja zločina.

programme.title: Ubistvo na kućnom pragu
programme.desc: Uz naraciju britanske glumice i voditeljke Kim Marš, serija "Ubistvo na mom kućnom pragu" istražuje slučajeve četvoro nedužnih ljudi koje je ubio neko u koga su imali poverenja. Ove priče pokazuju da je nečije sigurno mesto, utočište, istovremeno i prostor u kom mogu da budu najranjiviji. Tokom emisije, Kim Marš nam govori svojim specifičnim, empatičnim stilom, o tragičnim smrtima Eli Guld, Gagandipa Singa, Dženi Metven i Suzan Anis, žrtava koje su nesvesno otvorile svoja vrata zlu, i tako dočekale najveću izdaju u najličnijem okruženju. Detektivi, policajci, novinari i stručnjaci nas sprovode kroz istragu dok nas vode na ključne lokacije i objašnjavaju zaplete slučaja. Uz pomoć fotografija s mesta zločina i namenske snimke sa svake lokacije, vratićemo se tragom ubistava, a svaka epizoda će doneti zaokružen pogled na složene istrage pojedinačnih slučajeva, sa krajnjim ciljem da se otkriju motivi ubica.

programme.title: Izgradnja najluksuznijeg broda na svetu
programme.desc: IZGRADNJA NAJLUKSUZNIJEG BRODA NA SVETU prati inženjere i dizajnere koji žure da naprave Istraživača sedam mora _ najluksuzniji brod na svetu. Dokumentarac 18 meseci prati tim radnika na brodogradilištu koji se trude da hiljade metalnih ploča pretvore u luksuznu plutajuću palatu. Najskuplja soba na brodu ima koncertni klavir, ličnog batlera i sopstveni spa centar i košta 8.000 dolara za noć. Uprkos ovakvim cenama, prvo putovanje je rasprodato mnogo pre nego što je brod završen. Rok se približava. Da li će inženjeri uspeti da isporuče brod vredan 360 miliona dolara na vreme za prvu plovidbu?

Černobil, Bhopal, Deepwater Horizon, Titanik, Čelendžer i Hindenburg nisu zapamćeni po velikim inženjerskim dostignućima kakva su prvobitno bila, već po užasima u koje su se pretvorili. Kroz opsežne arhivske materijale i intervjue sa stručnjacima, ova serija istražuje priče iza najvećih inženjerskih katastrofa čovečanstva. Kako i zašto su se dogodile i šta smo iz njih naučili. Katastrofe nas uče više nego uspesi; svaki neuspeh pruža priliku za napredak i inovaciju, jer najveća tragedija bi bila nikada ne težiti napretku.

programme.title: Černobilska katastrofa
programme.desc: Katastrofa u Černobilju, dokumentarna serija u tri dela koju pripoveda Ben Fogle, iz minuta u minut prikazuje dramatične događaje koji su prethodili nuklearnoj nesreći 1986. godine, kao i borbu hiljada hrabrih ljudi da spreče dalje širenje katastrofe. Kroz svedočenja ljudi koji su se neposredno našli u središtu tragedije, onih koji su rizikovali živote učestvujući u saniranju posledica, kao i kroz analizu nedavno objavljenih dokumenata KGB-a, serijal otkriva neverovatnu istinitu priču o jednoj od najtežih nuklearnih nesreća u istoriji. Serijal se bavi i dugoročnim posledicama černobiljske katastrofe, uključujući događaje iz 2022. godine, kada su ruske snage tokom rata u Ukrajini preuzele kontrolu nad područjem Černobilja.

programme.title: Šenžen: Najfuturističkiji grad sveta
programme.desc: Općenito se smatra jednim od najnaprednijih i najfuturističkijih gradova na svijetu. U Šenzenu ljudi mogu plaćati dlanom ruke. Hrana za van dostavlja se bespilotnim letjelicama, putnike do odredišta prevoze taksiji bez vozača, a hotele čiste "uslužni roboti". Ondje mreža brojnih nadzornih kamera ne samo da bilježi kretanje ljudi, već je sposobna analizirati ponašanje i odmah dojaviti policiji svaku sumnjivu aktivnost. Prema službenim podacima, stopa kriminala na javnim mjestima pala je za 80% u prvih 15 godina nakon postavljanja kamera. No, ta sveprisutna tehnologija kineskim je vlastima također omogućila učvršćivanje moći, čineći javno iskazivanje neslaganja gotovo nemogućim.

programme.title: Vilem i Frida: Falsifikatori protiv nacista
programme.desc: Tokom okupacije Holandije u Drugom svetskom ratu, Vilem Arondus, slikar, i Frida Belinfante, čelistkinja, koristili su svoje umetničke veštine da lažiraju lične karte koje su spasile hiljade Jevreja od logora smrti. To nije bio lak zadatak jer su, u to vreme, Holanđani imali najsloženiji sistem ličnih karti na svetu, i štaviše, nacisti su imali pametan plan: duplikat svake lične karte koju bi izdali su čuvali u Centralnom arhivu u Amsterdamu, kako bi sprečili falsifikate. Vilem je shvatio da mora nešto da preduzme, i uz skrpljenu bandu kolega umetnika, predvodio je odvažan pohod na Centralni arhiv kako bi u eksploziji uništio sve duplikate ličnih karata. Postojao je samo jedan uslov: niko ne sme da bude povređen usput, jer "mi nismo kao oni". Stiven Fraj kreće na jedno lično putovanje u Amsterdam kako bi otkrio zašto je ova neverovatna priča ostala većim delom sakrivena za istoriju, sve do danas.

programme.title: Moj tata i čista hemija: neverovatni diler droge
programme.desc: Inspirisana memoarima svog sina Džejmsa Breaking Dad, ova priča neverovatnija od fikcije donosi upozoravajuću pouku: Ričard rizikuje sve, menjajući svoj udoban život za život u kriminalu, u trenutku kada jedna od najadiktivnijih droga na planeti prodire u samo srce londonske klupske scene. Ovo je priča o potpuno neverovatnom liku koji je doprineo usponu metamfetamina u Britaniji početkom 2000-ih — i o tome kako je policija na kraju uspela da ga uhvati. Ponekad šokantna, često za nepoverovati, ali sve vreme 100% istinita.
